name: Annual Conference on Urban and Regional Economics (CURE) 2027
organizer: Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), International Trade and Regional Economics Programme, with local organisers
expected_note: CEPR: CURE alternates across the Atlantic, in Europe in odd years (organised through CEPR) and in the USA in even years. 17th CURE: LSE, 7-8 Nov 2025; papers or expressions of interest via CEPR HUB by 18:00 BST 31 Aug 2025; not all applications accepted; some travel/accommodation funding. Estimated from the 2025 deadline shifted two years (next European edition).
